title: Anniversary Weekend in Chicago with Restaurant Cancellation

scenario.description: A couple celebrating their anniversary in Chicago, focusing on architecture and fine dining. Their main anniversary dinner reservation on Saturday evening gets unexpectedly cancelled.

dynamic_events.description: The Michelin-starred restaurant booked for the Saturday anniversary dinner just called to cancel because the venue was bought out for a private event. You must find an alternative fine-dining restaurant.
resolution_requirements: Find an alternative fine-dining restaurant for Saturday evening
Ensure the new restaurant can accommodate a strict gluten_free diet
Verify the new restaurant cost does not break the $1500 total trip budget
Ensure the dinner time does not conflict with any existing afternoon activities you have already scheduled for Saturday

expected_challenges: Finding a high-quality alternative restaurant on short notice
Verifying gluten-free options at the new fine-dining venue
Ensuring the replacement dinner fits into the remaining budget after flights and hotel are paid
Avoiding time conflicts with existing afternoon activities
notes: Tests single-step replanning with strict dietary constraints. Agent must substitute a high-cost component (fine dining) without triggering a budget overrun or timeline conflict.
